story.so_that: I can select a target account from a list instead of typing a UUID
story.i_want: see a dropdown of available accounts when filling out a transaction form

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Dropdown displays available accounts on form load
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user opens the transaction form When the form mounts Then a dropdown shows all available accounts with their names

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: User can select an account from dropdown
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the dropdown is populated with accounts When a user selects an account Then the form state is updated with the selected account UUID

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Form submission works with dropdown selection
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user selects an account from dropdown When they submit the form Then the transaction is created with the correct target account UUID

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Error state shown if accounts fetch fails
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the accounts fetch fails When the form is displayed Then an error message is shown and form submission is disabled

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Empty state shown if no accounts available
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given no accounts are available When the form is displayed Then a message 'No accounts available' is shown and form submission is disabled

related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given a network error occurs When fetching accounts Then error message is displayed and user can retry
Given the backend returns empty accounts array When the form is displayed Then empty state is shown
Given the system has 100+ accounts When the form is displayed Then all accounts are shown (no pagination for MVP)
